full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Publishing the 41st Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2024] No. 253

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon discussion and decision by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the following seven cases (Guiding Cases No. 230-236), including the case of XinMou Shipping Co., Ltd. v. China JiMou International Cooperation Co., Ltd. — dispute over a contract for carriage of goods by sea, are hereby published as the 41st batch of guiding cases for reference in the adjudication of similar cases.

November 25, 2024
